title: DPWH’s proposed changes in 2027 budget include flood control projects – Dizon
summary: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is proposing changes to its 2027 budget worth around P20 billion, which will involve flood control projects, according to DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon.
